flow.title: Review, decide and save
flow.lead: The detailed diagram includes sources, Python, files and context. The short diagram shows the main work loop.

goal.label: Goal
goal.text: Who needs a reply, what needs doing and what I am waiting for. Every item has a clear next step.

nodes.label: You ask for COMMS7
paragraphs: Type COMMS7 in chat. AI loads the skill and its instructions. You can ask for the overall priorities, Action, Waiting or a specific conversation.
If you ask for a skill or workflow explanation, AI works on the explanation. A communication review starts when that is your goal.
nodes.what: Type COMMS7 in chat. AI loads the skill and its instructions. You can ask for the overall priorities, Action, Waiting or a specific conversation.
nodes.out: AI understands the help you want.
nodes.example: COMMS7 — what matters now in Gmail and WhatsApp?  /  COMMS7 — review current Waiting.
nodes.summary: Tell the chat what to review. AI loads COMMS7.

nodes.label: Agree on scope
paragraphs: AI uses your request, previous decisions and Business context. Agree on the goal, channels, accounts and review depth; do not ask again for information already supplied.
If you type only “COMMS7”, AI proposes a useful starting point, such as important unanswered requests and open promises. It asks a follow-up when the answer changes what should be reviewed.
Current FOCUS7 priorities inform importance. CRM7 provides the matched person’s latest professional context where a granted reader is available. Reading does not grant CRM writes.
nodes.what: AI uses your request, previous decisions and Business context. Agree on the goal, channels, accounts and review depth; do not ask again for information already supplied.
nodes.out: A clear review scope and expected result.
nodes.summary: AI uses what you already said and asks only for details that change the review.

nodes.label: Open the review record
paragraphs: AI reads saved state so older open items remain and completed actions do not return.
Record the goal, sources and clarifications for this review. Existing CRM and tasks remain in their authoritative home; the review links to them.
nodes.what: Before checking new messages, AI reads the saved current state. This preserves older open items and avoids repeating work already completed or deliberately ignored.
nodes.out: A review record and a known starting state.
nodes.summary: AI reads previous state and records this review’s goal, accounts and clarifications.

stored.title: Agreed private review home
stored.text: Keep the review ID/date, purpose, source coverage, decisions and links to authoritative task records, in the agreed Markdown or JSON format.

nodes.label: Check the sources
paragraphs: AI or the granted reader retrieves agreed account data and states coverage, freshness and gaps.
For structured input, review_pack.py merges duplicate actions and compares current evidence with the previous review. Unchanged closed items stay resolved; older open items remain.
Python processes structure, not meaning. Before recommending action, AI checks required full context, latest replies and deadline evidence.
nodes.what: In one step, AI checks every agreed source. Your current use centres on Gmail and WhatsApp. For each account it states coverage, freshness and any gap.
nodes.out: Checked conversation facts, source links and explicit coverage.
nodes.summary: Collect the agreed sources and coverage. Python builds a compact pack; AI reads full conversation context when needed.

helper.title: Python · change selection and merging
helper.text: review_pack.py is built and tested on synthetic inputs. It produces compact JSON, open items and decision progress. Account connectors remain separate.

nodes.label: Show the priorities
paragraphs: AI compares new information with saved decisions and separates my actions, waiting on others, resolved items and information requiring no action. An old open promise remains even without a new message.
Chat first shows up to five priority next actions. Each has a clear reason, one question or action, an owner and the relevant source. Other open items remain in the record.
The review file keeps the summary, source IDs and status decisions needed to continue. There is no need to copy entire mailboxes and chats.
nodes.what: AI compares new information with saved decisions and separates my actions, waiting on others, resolved items and information requiring no action. An old open promise remains even without a new message.
nodes.out: You have a short action list and AI has the review record needed to continue.
nodes.summary: AI checks conversation context and highlights up to five priority next actions. Evidence remains in the review record.

stored.title: The record keeps the evidence
stored.text: Relevant conversation IDs, summaries and open questions. No need to copy the whole mailbox.

nodes.label: Decide and act
paragraphs: Work through the items in chat. AI explains the situation, drafts a reply or prepares the next action. You can say “sent”, “done”, “waiting for a reply”, “defer until…” or “ignore this”. External sending follows the specific task authorisation.

After each decision, AI updates the review record and the relevant existing state entry. “Sent” records that reply; an outstanding delivery or promise stays open. Current state shows actions and waits.

Align Gmail labels with evidenced state: Action, Waiting, Someday/Maybe or Read/Later, using existing account names. Verify authorised changes by reading them back. Without a writer, show the suggestion and pending change. Review filters and subscriptions when needed.
Progress shows the share of items raised in this review that have an explicit decision and next step. It appears in chat and the review record. A newly raised question also increases the total.

WAITING is decided for this review when we know who owes what and when to check again. DEFER needs a date or clear trigger. 100% means every review item has a decision; external obligations can remain open.
nodes.what: Work through the items in chat. AI explains the situation, drafts a reply or prepares the next action. You can say “sent”, “done”, “waiting for a reply”, “defer until…” or “ignore this”. External sending follows the specific task authorisation.
nodes.out: Each reviewed item has a decision, saved state and a next check where needed.

stored.title: Update the review and current state
stored.text: Save the outcome and next step after each decision. WAITING remains open. Python can calculate progress from structured decisions; unified live-source integration still needs acceptance.

nodes.label: Save and close
paragraphs: When you end the review, chat or day, AI states what is done, what remains open and when to return. The target is an explicit decision for every item raised.
If a question is undecided, preserve and name it instead of claiming 100%. Unavailable sources and unchecked conversations remain explicit review limits.
At EXIT7, AI saves the record and current state, verifies readback and leaves a clear continuation. The next review starts from saved state and checks new messages.

principles.title: How COMMS7 chooses the next action
principles.lead: COMMS7 looks for unresolved commitments and their next step. An unread message is not itself a task; your promise can remain open after sending a reply.

sections.title: What the main SKILL.md contains
sections.text: AI starts with this file: purpose, invocation mode, selection rules, context sources and limits. The detailed run contract and optional modes live in linked files loaded when relevant.

rows.label: 1. Who is addressed?
rows.text: Is the request directed at you or someone whose work you coordinate? A group mention alone creates no task.

rows.label: 2. What is unresolved?
rows.text: Identify the actual question, your promise, expected result or deadline, then one verifiable next step.

rows.label: 3. Is it already resolved?
rows.text: Check the latest thread, sent messages, other authorised channels and your previous decision.

rows.label: 4. Why now?
rows.text: Use actual deadlines, consequences, person context and accepted FOCUS7 priorities. Do not invent urgency.

rows.label: 5. What does evidence support?
rows.text: Recommend replying, doing, calling, waiting, deferring or skipping. If required context is missing, state the gap.

sections.title: How decisions appear in Gmail

rows.label: Action / Waiting
rows.text: I need to act or am waiting on someone else. A sent reply can leave a promised delivery open; both labels can be justified on one thread.

rows.label: Someday/Maybe / Read/Later
rows.text: An optional future idea or selected reading. A deferred commitment keeps its action and restart date.

rows.label: Filters and subscriptions
rows.text: Proposes repeatable sorting or unsubscribe with a reason. Executes the concrete change only after acceptance and with an available tool.

sections.note: Uses existing account label names. “Suggested” and “applied and verified in Gmail” are different results.

sections.title: What this changes in practice

items.title: “Thanks!”
items.text: With no new question or commitment, no reply or task is needed.

items.title: “I will send the slides tomorrow”
items.text: The reply may be sent while the promised delivery remains open.

items.title: “I will reply on Friday”
items.text: Wait for the other party until the agreed date; do not invent an earlier reminder.

items.title: Promotion or newsletter
items.text: Usually requires no reply. Relevant reading can be considered through NEWS7 when that is your task.

sections.note: An AI suggestion is not an accepted task. You decide; DONE closes only the named action.

rows.label: Gmail / WhatsApp
rows.text: Read received and sent context for the authorised account; a Gmail snippet or WhatsApp metadata alone is not a full review.

rows.label: CRM7
rows.text: Match the person and read relevant recent context where the granted tool is available.

rows.label: Calendar and documents
rows.text: Use when needed to verify a particular deadline, availability or delivery.

rows.label: Other channels
rows.text: Additional sources need a named account, permissions and verified coverage.

sections.title: COMMS7 in your AIOS system
sections.text: System integration: high. COMMS7 can review supplied conversations on its own. With AIOS it also knows your direction, active commitments and relationship history, so selection is specific to your work.

rows.label: 01 · Constitution
rows.text: North Star and working principles guide which opportunities deserve attention, alongside real deadlines and existing obligations.

rows.label: 02 · Memory
rows.text: Project and relationship history explains what was agreed. Accepted business conclusions return to the correct project or CRM home; private messages keep their protected audience.

rows.label: 03 · Skills
rows.text: FOCUS7, CRM7 and relevant delivery methods coordinate the next step with permitted agent roles. One skill does not duplicate their authorities.

rows.label: 04 · Tools
rows.text: Uses the same shared, permitted mail, messaging, CRM and calendar connections as other work. Every source still needs real verified capability.

rows.label: 05 · Focus
rows.text: Active goals, projects, tasks and deliberate pauses show what matters now. A fresh message does not silently create a new priority.

sections.note: High is a qualitative dependency assessment, not a measured quality score. Standalone use needs you to provide this context manually. Integration keeps it available between reviews; missing context must remain visible.

items.title: Used on its own
items.text: Can identify questions, promises and deadlines in supplied conversations. You provide the goals, history and priorities.

items.title: Within AIOS
items.text: Uses accepted direction and current context, remembers decisions and preserves the handoff in the right place. Less repeated explanation.
